library: Snapshot delivery, scope presentation, and disabling zero-selection actions.
application: Objects, versions, scope, permissions, consequences, and execution outcomes.

metadata.title: 动作组 ButtonGroup
metadata.description: 为同一范围的动作提供共同名称与间隔。

metadata.decisions: 共同名称说明范围，每个按钮仍说明自己的动作。ButtonGroup 不选择按钮、不传播禁用，也不建立工具栏键盘行为。
metadata.decisionsEn: The shared name identifies the scope; each button still names its action. ButtonGroup adds no selection, disabled propagation or toolbar keyboard behavior.

avoid: 用动作组替代单选、多选或工具栏。
composition: 复用 Group 和 action-gap；成员使用 Button，真实状态仍在成员处表达。

responsive: 横向默认换行，也可纵向；不合并成员轮廓。
customization: className 与 render 属于组；不统一改写子按钮。

whenToUse: Several actions share a named scope.
avoid: Replacing single/multiple selection or a toolbar with an action group.
composition: Use Group and action-gap; Button members retain their own actual states.

library: Native group semantics and action spacing.
application: Scope, name, and each action's state.

customization: className and render belong to the group; do not rewrite every child Button.

api.name: ButtonGroup

metadata.title: 按钮 Button
metadata.description: 触发有明确对象与后果的动作；状态由调用方持有。
metadata.descriptionEn: Trigger a named action with a clear object and consequence. The caller owns its state.
metadata.decisions: 等待、进行中、结果未知期间保留焦点并阻止重复触发。结果未知需要调用方先核实；危险动作必须与可见后果共处，色调不代表授权。
metadata.decisionsEn: Waiting, in-progress, and unknown states retain focus and block repeated activation. The caller must verify an unknown result. Danger actions require a visible consequence; tone never grants permission.

whenToUse: 执行有对象与后果的命令、提交表单或停止当前任务。
avoid: 导航用原生链接；不把等待结束当作成功，不把未知当作失败或可立即重试。
composition: 危险动作使用 ButtonProtection，或由自身 aria-describedby 关联已有的非空后果说明；确认条件、权限与远端核实属于应用。

library: 原生与非原生命令语义、焦点、激活保护、动作名称及 locale 状态表达。
application: 对象、范围、后果、权限、请求事实、核实、恢复与取消后台任务。

responsive: 尺寸按位置选择；长标签可换行增高，图标形态保留同档几何；触摸命中区独立于外观。
customization: variant、tone、size 与 shape 分别选择呈现、后果、尺寸与内容形态。

whenToUse: Run a command with an object and consequence, submit a form, or stop the current task.
avoid: Use native links for navigation. Finished waiting does not establish success, and unknown is neither failure nor permission to retry immediately.
composition: Danger actions use ButtonProtection or aria-describedby associated with existing nonblank consequence text. Applications own confirmation criteria, permissions, and remote verification.

library: Native and non-native command semantics, focus, activation guards, action names, and localized states.
application: Objects, scope, consequences, permissions, request facts, verification, recovery, and background cancellation.

responsive: Choose dimensions for position; long labels may wrap and grow, icons retain matching geometry, and touch targets remain separate from appearance.
customization: variant, tone, size, and shape independently select presentation, consequence, dimensions, and content form.

api.name: Button
api.description: 默认渲染 type=button 的原生按钮，透传原生属性、ref、事件和派生 data-slot。状态不会自行推进。
api.descriptionEn: Renders a native type=button control by default and forwards native attributes, refs, events, and derived data-slot values. It never advances its own operation state.

props.name: variant
props.description: 填充、边框或无边框的表达，不表示权限。
props.descriptionEn: Filled, bordered, or borderless presentation; it does not express permission.

props.name: tone
props.description: 动作后果；danger 使用 ButtonProtection，或 aria-describedby 关联文档中已有的非空说明。开发环境挂载后校验；生产环境不抛错。
props.descriptionEn: The action's consequence. Use ButtonProtection or aria-describedby linked to existing nonblank text. Development validation runs after mounting; production does not throw.

props.name: size
props.description: 按所在位置选尺寸，与强调独立。
props.descriptionEn: Choose by position, independently of emphasis.

props.name: shape
props.description: 图标是形态；icon 必须有 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby。
props.descriptionEn: Icon is a shape, not another size. Supply aria-label or aria-labelledby for it.

props.name: state
props.description: 调用方持有的事实。等待与进行中设置 aria-busy；结果未知单独呈现。前三种未完成状态阻止重复触发，failed 可由调用方提供恢复操作。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-owned facts. Waiting and in-progress set aria-busy; unknown remains distinct. Those three states block repeat activation. The caller may provide recovery after confirmed failure.

props.name: disabled
props.description: 动作不可用，退出 Tab 顺序；与未完成事实可以共存。
props.descriptionEn: Makes the action unavailable and removes it from the tab order. It may coexist with an unfinished state.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI 组合入口，可渲染其他命令载体或触发器；保留真实语义。
props.descriptionEn: The Base UI composition entry for another command carrier or trigger. Preserve its actual semantics.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: 非 button 命令载体设为 false，仍使用按钮语义；导航使用原生 a + buttonVariants。
props.descriptionEn: Set false for a non-button command carrier; it retains button semantics. Use a native anchor with buttonVariants for navigation.

api.name: ButtonProtection
api.description: 可见后果与动作成组，并关联 aria-describedby；已有说明可由 Button 直接关联。容器的 consequence 必须非空，不替应用确认、判断权限或执行请求。
api.descriptionEn: Groups a visible consequence with actions and links aria-describedby. A Button can directly reference an existing description instead. The container requires nonblank consequence text; it does not confirm, authorize, or run a request.

props.name: consequence
props.description: 必填非空文字，说明当前对象、版本与变更的后果。
props.descriptionEn: Required nonblank text describing the consequence for the current object, version, and change.

props.name: children
props.description: 相关动作与必要退出入口。
props.descriptionEn: Related actions and any required exit.

api.name: buttonVariants
api.description: 与 Button 同一套尺寸、形态、强调和色调，用于保留原生链接等元素语义的组合。
api.descriptionEn: The same size, shape, emphasis, and tone styles for compositions that retain native element semantics, such as links.

api.name: ButtonPrimitive
api.description: Base UI 无障碍原语；应用优先使用 Button 的状态与保护契约。
api.descriptionEn: The Base UI accessibility primitive. Prefer Button's state and protection contract in applications.

keyboard.description: 触发可用动作；等待、进行中或结果未知时不触发。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Activate an available action. Waiting, in-progress, and unknown actions do not activate.

keyboard.description: 移入或移出焦点；未完成状态保留位置，disabled 退出 Tab 顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move focus. Unfinished states retain their position; disabled actions leave the tab order.

keyboard.description: 组合菜单或列表触发器按原语操作；未完成状态阻止展开。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Follow the primitive's menu or list trigger behavior. Unfinished states block opening.

notes: 动作可访问名称保持不变；状态通过独立 description 与 live region 表达。文字形态同时显示状态文字，图标形态使用不同状态图形。
危险色调不代表授权。后果必须真实说明当前对象；确认条件与核实结果由调用方负责。
danger 的 DOM 关联在挂载后的 effect 校验：同次挂载的相邻说明可被找到；SSR 不校验，开发环境提交 DOM 后才报错。后续异步才出现的说明应先挂载再启用 danger。生产环境不抛错；文本存在不等于后果正确或可见，调用方仍需核对。
结果未知默认阻止重复执行；调用方应提供独立核实入口，收到可靠事实后再更新 state。
导航使用原生 a / Link + buttonVariants；nativeButton=false 的 Button 仍是命令语义。
小控件通过 touch-target 扩大命中区到本库 44px 目标，密度与外观尺寸不改变这一目标。
实心入口与父表面对比不足时，消费组合通过 className 添加可辨认边界，并使用同档 padding-bordered；同底色边界示例展示这一入口，组件不读取 DOM 推断承载面。
notesEn: The action's accessible name stays unchanged. Status uses a separate description and live region. Label buttons also display status text; icon buttons use distinct status glyphs.
Danger tone grants no permission. Describe the consequence for the actual object; the caller owns confirmation conditions and verification.

The danger association is checked in an effect after mounting. Adjacent text mounted in the same commit is available. SSR skips validation; development throws after DOM commit. Mount asynchronous descriptions before enabling danger. Production does not throw. Text presence alone does not prove a correct or visible consequence; the caller must verify it.
Unknown results block repeated execution by default. Provide a separate verification action and update state only after reliable facts arrive.
Use a native anchor or router Link with buttonVariants for navigation. A nativeButton=false Button remains a command.
touch-target expands small controls to the library's 44px touch target without changing visual dimensions or shrinking it with density.

When a solid action lacks contrast with its parent, the consumer adds a visible boundary through className and uses the matching padding-bordered profile. The same-surface example demonstrates this entry; the component does not inspect the DOM to infer its surface.

metadata.title: 日历 Calendar

api.name: Calendar
api.description: 复用安装版 DayPicker 的日期、年月、键盘与选择语义。

props.name: mode / selected / onSelect / required
props.description: single、multiple、range 各按公开原语类型组合；选中值归调用方，required 限制原语取消选择。
props.descriptionEn: Use the public single, multiple, or range union. The caller owns selection; required limits deselection.

props.name: month / defaultMonth / onMonthChange
props.description: 受控或非受控年月导航；未指定时采用 DayPicker 当前月份默认值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled month navigation; the primitive defaults to the current month.

props.name: disabled / hidden / startMonth / endMonth
props.description: 明确不可选日期、隐藏日期与导航范围。disabled 不替调用方纠正已有选中值。

props.name: min / max / excludeDisabled
props.description: 范围长度与跨禁用日期的规则由调用方显式声明。默认允许同日完整范围。

props.name: size

props.name: locale / labels / formatters

props.descriptionEn: Chinese/English date language and names follow UILocale. Supply a DayPicker locale for other date languages.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / classNames / components

api.name: formatLocalDate / parseLocalDate

api.name: CalendarPrimitive
api.description: 安装版 @daypicker/react 命名空间。

keyboard.description: 由日期原语在真实日历网格中移动焦点。

keyboard.description: 按日期原语规则导航年月。

keyboard.description: 选择聚焦日期，遵守 disabled 与当前选择模式。

application: 选中日期、范围、年月约束与无效事实

responsive: 五档同名文字，窄屏 +4px，粗指针实体单元命中
customization: CalendarProps、classNames、components 与集中主题角色

whenToUse: View local calendar dates and select a date.
avoid: The application must establish rules for zoned values or instants first.

library: Date grid, keyboard behavior, and uncontrolled navigation.

metadata.title: 卡片 Card
metadata.description: 为可独立识别的对象建立内容边界。
metadata.descriptionEn: Bound an independently identifiable object.

api.name: Card
api.description: 面板表面、边界与圆角。不生成标题、内容槽、内边距或排列方式。
api.descriptionEn: Panel surface, boundary and radius. It supplies no title, content slots, padding or layout.

props.name: render
props.description: 组合为 article、section 或原生链接，完整保留事件与 ref。
props.descriptionEn: Compose an article, section or native link while retaining handlers and refs.

props.name: className / style
props.description: 消费端按对象关系组合布局与内缘；外部类最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Compose layout and content inset for this object. Caller classes are merged last.

props.name: 原生属性
props.description: 透传 id、aria-*、data-*、事件与 ref。
props.descriptionEn: Forward id, aria-*, data-*, events and ref.

metadata.decisions: 对象无需独立识别、排序或操作时，用标题与间距组织内容。整张 Card 是链接时，内部不能再嵌套按钮或其他链接。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use headings and spacing when content has no independent identity, ordering or actions. A Card rendered as a link cannot contain other links or buttons.
notes: 标题用 Heading 或真实 h2/h3；内容与动作由 Stack、Inline 和原生结构组合。
size、CardHeader/Title/Description/Action/Panel/Content/Footer 与 CardFrame* 已移除。
只有同一轮廓等距内缩时才计算内圆角；独立子控件保留自身圆角。
密度、方向与语言由容器继承；Card 不写入这些标记。
当前默认只有线、面与圆角，没有阴影；这是可逆外观选择，项目按实际关系组合阴影。
notesEn: Use Heading or a real h2/h3, and compose content and actions with Stack, Inline and native structure.
size, CardHeader/Title/Description/Action/Panel/Content/Footer and CardFrame* have been removed.
Calculate an inner radius only for an equally inset contour of the same surface. Independent controls keep their own radii.
Density, direction and language belong to the containing context. Card sets no such markers.
The current default uses a boundary, surface and radius without a shadow. This is a reversible appearance choice; projects can compose shadows where appropriate.

whenToUse: 对象需要独立识别、排序或操作，其边界参与任务关系。
avoid: 去掉边框关系不变的内容；整卡链接嵌套交互；用卡片代替所有分节。
composition: 仅消费 Card 边界；Heading、Stack、Inline、原生表单与列表负责内容关系。

library: 面板边界、表面、圆角与 render 透传。
application: 对象身份、标题级别、布局、草稿与异步事实。

responsive: 消费端允许长标题和动作换行；比较任务保留必要维度。
customization: 通过集中主题调整面板角色，内容布局由组合提供。

whenToUse: An object needs independent identification, ordering, or actions whose boundary supports the task.
avoid: Content whose relationships survive border removal; nested interaction inside a whole-card link; cards for every section.
composition: Consume Card's boundary only; Heading, Stack, Inline, native forms, and lists organize content relationships.

library: Panel boundary, surface, radius, and render forwarding.
application: Object identity, heading levels, layout, drafts, and asynchronous facts.

responsive: Consumers permit long titles and actions to wrap; comparisons retain necessary dimensions.
customization: Adjust panel roles through the central theme; composition supplies content layout.

metadata.title: 顺序阅读 Carousel

metadata.decisions: 位置不代表已经阅读或完成；默认不播放、不环回。只有当前项可达，所有项保持原生输入。

api.description: 有名称的阅读region、原生ScrollArea与Button前后入口。

props.description: 当前项id与变更请求；受控值由调用方接受。非受控项移除后回到首个现存项。

props.name: emptyContent

keyboard.description: 访问当前项及前后控件，关闭项不可达。

metadata.title: 真实数值 Chart
metadata.description: 以同源图形、轴、图例和可见数值表呈现真实数据。
metadata.descriptionEn: Present real data with a same-source plot, axes, legend and visible numeric table.
metadata.decisions: 已知0、无记录、未知和不适用分别成立；未知值形成gap，表格保留其真实名称。图形不替代可达数值。
metadata.decisionsEn: Known zero, empty data, unknown and not-applicable values remain distinct. Unavailable values form gaps and retain their actual names in the table. Plots do not replace reachable numbers.

api.name: Chart
api.description: figure名称、共同轴量纲、不同系列形态与同源可见Table。
api.descriptionEn: A named figure, shared axis units, distinct series shapes and a visible same-source Table.

props.name: label
props.description: 非空真实语义名称。
props.descriptionEn: A nonempty semantic name for the actual data.

props.name: state
props.description: 真实整图事实；非ready由children表达，不造数字或坐标轴。
props.descriptionEn: The actual chart-wide state. children describe non-data states without invented numbers or axes.

props.name: categoryLabel / valueLabel
props.description: 非空分类轴名与共享量纲/单位。
props.descriptionEn: Nonempty category axis name and shared value units.

props.name: series
props.description: 1至5个有唯一key与名称的同量纲系列，消费现有chart1..5及可区分marker/line。
props.descriptionEn: One to five named series with unique keys and shared units, using existing chart1..5 colors and distinct markers/lines.

props.name: rows
props.description: 稳定id、分类名称与values；值为finite number或{state:unknown|not-applicable,label}。ready必须有真实记录。
props.descriptionEn: Stable ids, category names and values: finite numbers or explicitly named unknown/not-applicable values. ready requires actual records.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: 格式化已知数值；默认按UILocale数值Intl，不改数据。
props.descriptionEn: Format known values without changing data. Defaults to Intl number formatting for UILocale.

props.name: renderPlot
props.description: 替换同源图形；gap为null，默认LineChart不连接gap且不动画。名称、图例与可见Table始终保留。自定义图形承担自身交互/ARIA。
props.descriptionEn: Replace the same-source plot. Gaps project to null; the default LineChart neither connects gaps nor animates. Names, legend and visible Table remain. Custom plots own their interaction and ARIA.

props.name: style / className / render / ref
props.description: 根style覆写局部plot-height/stroke-width/marker-size角色；默认12em/2px/8px为集中预设，实际图形和图例消费。
props.descriptionEn: Root style overrides local plot-height/stroke-width/marker-size roles. Defaults of 12em/2px/8px are centralized presets consumed by the plot and legend.

notes: null、NaN、Infinity、缺失键不能表示0；用显式unknown或not-applicable表达。
所有值均未知时不画虚假数值轴，名称、图例与表格保留。
默认图形为数值表的视觉补充，辅助技术使用可见表；自定义renderPlot不被强制aria-hidden。
长名称在可见Table保留，图形轴的公共碰撞处理不表示记录丢失。
浅深必要图形对真实背景至少3:1、文字至少4.5:1，由浏览器owner核实。
notesEn: null, NaN, Infinity and missing keys cannot stand for zero. Use explicit unknown or not-applicable values.
When every value is unavailable, no fabricated numeric axis is drawn; names, legend and table remain.
The default plot supplements the visible numeric table, which provides assistive access. Custom renderPlot content is not forced aria-hidden.
The visible Table retains full names. Axis collision handling does not mean records are missing.
The browser owner verifies light/dark contrast: necessary graphics at least 3:1 against the actual background and text at least 4.5:1.

whenToUse: Real values in shared units need graphical comparison with reachable numeric equivalents.
avoid: Mixed units, guessed results, connecting unavailable values as a reliable trend, or relying on color alone.
composition: Public Recharts primitives with current Table and Empty; one rows/series projection.

library: Same-source projection, visible equivalent table, series shapes and basic naming.
application: Data, units, truth, state content and custom plotting.

responsive: A centralized 12em plot height can be overridden. The table scrolls and wraps without cutting actual values.
customization: Existing chart1..5 semantic colors, local plot roles and public renderPlot; no separate chart palette.

whenToUse: 真实共享量纲数据需要图形比较，且等价值可达。
avoid: 混合量纲、猜测结果、把缺值连成可靠趋势或仅靠颜色。
composition: Recharts公开原语 + 当前Table/Empty；同一rows/series投影。

library: 同源投影、可见等价表、系列形态和基础名称。
application: 数据、量纲、真实性、状态文字与自定义图形。

responsive: 图高集中12em可覆写，表格原生滚动/换行；不裁掉实际值。
customization: chart1..5语义角色；局部plot roles与公开renderPlot，不另造图表调色板。

metadata.title: 文件输入 FileUpload
metadata.description: 选择或拖入本地文件，保留已接受集合与真实拒绝原因。
metadata.descriptionEn: Choose or drop local files, retaining accepted files and real rejection reasons.
metadata.decisions: 组件只管理本地文件选择。上传状态、进度分母、失败、结果未知与恢复由应用提供；它不发请求、不制造进度、不从 Promise 推断结果。
metadata.decisionsEn: The component manages local selection only. The application supplies upload states, progress denominators, failure, unknown results, and recovery. It sends no requests, invents no progress, and infers no result from a Promise.

api.name: FileUpload
api.description: 原生 file Input、拖放、已接受列表与真实规则验证的组合。
api.descriptionEn: A native file input composed with dropping, accepted files, and real rule validation.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: readonly File[] / readonly File[] / (files, details) => void
props.description: 受控或非受控接受集合，保留 File 引用。details 含 select/drop/remove、added/removed/event/cancel()；受控拒绝或取消不改变提交集合。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled accepted files, retaining File references. details includes select/drop/remove, added, removed, event, and cancel(). Refusal or cancellation preserves submitted files.

props.name: accept / maxSize / maxFiles
props.description: 扩展名/MIME规则、每文件字节数、集合数量。大小与数量为非负安全整数，省略不限制；按 type/size/count 的实际首个失败理由拒绝，已知外部集合不静默纠正。
props.descriptionEn: Extension/MIME rules, bytes per file, and collection count. Size and count are nonnegative safe integers; omitted means unlimited. Reject with the first actual type/size/count failure; external sets are not silently repaired.

props.name: multiple
props.description: 默认是集合选择；false 的集合容量最多1，已有文件须先移除才能加入另一个，不隐式替换。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to collection selection. false limits capacity to one; remove an existing file before adding another, with no implicit replacement.

props.name: onReject
props.description: 真实 type/size/count 拒绝；拒绝项可关闭提示，但不冒充已接受文件。
props.descriptionEn: Actual type/size/count rejections. Dismissing feedback does not make rejected files accepted.

props.name: name / form
props.description: chooser 不带最终 name；Field 可提供名称，公开 formdata 事件 append 已接受 File，不覆盖同名其它字段。显式 form 支持外部表单。
props.descriptionEn: The chooser has no final name. Field may supply it; the public formdata event appends accepted Files without replacing other same-name fields. form supports external forms.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 阻止选择、拖放和移除；Field/原生 fieldset 禁用同样约束。只读文件继续提交，禁用排除。原生 reset 未取消时非受控恢复初始 defaultValue，受控值保留。
props.descriptionEn: Block selecting, dropping, and removing, including Field/native fieldset disabled. Read-only submits; disabled is excluded. Uncanceled native reset restores initial uncontrolled defaultValue and retains controlled values.

props.name: getStatus
props.description: 调用方真实 waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success 与可见 label。只有 in-progress 可提供 {value, min?, max}；max 是调用方已知分母，null 为不定进度。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-provided waiting/in-progress/failed/unknown/success and a visible label. Only in-progress accepts {value,min?,max}; max is a known denominator and null is indeterminate.

props.name: renderFileActions
props.description: 应用的实际恢复/核对入口，组件不自动执行；本地移除不表示取消上传或删除服务端对象。
props.descriptionEn: Real application recovery/check actions, never executed automatically. Local removal does not imply canceling an upload or deleting a server object.

props.name: size / inputProps / render / ref / ARIA / events
props.type: InputSize / current Input props / div composition
props.description: 原生输入与动作同档；Input 出口支持 render/ref/events。required 不暴露，chooser 会清空；集合必填由应用按当前 value 校验并用 FieldError 表达。
props.descriptionEn: Native input and actions share one profile. Input supports render, refs, and events. required is not exposed because the chooser clears; validate the current set in the application with FieldError.

api.name: FileUploadPrimitive
api.description: 所用安装版 Input 原语命名空间。
api.descriptionEn: The installed Input primitive namespace.

keyboard.description: 到真实原生文件入口并选择；只读阻止修改。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach and activate the real native file chooser; read-only blocks changes.

keyboard.description: 移除已接受本地文件或关闭拒绝提示；应用恢复入口遵守其自身事实。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Remove accepted local files or dismiss rejections; recovery actions follow application facts.

notes: 对象身份决定集合成员；不凭同名/大小猜文件内容相同。移除后可重新选择同一文件；聚焦行移除回相邻动作或 chooser，受控拒绝不夺焦点。
Field 保留 Label/error/disabled 连接；实际 chooser 的 name/value/required 隔离，避免提交草稿或恒 invalid。
需要支持 formdata 的浏览器；jsdom 事件桥接不等于已验证原生 FormData 构造行为。

Field retains label/error/disabled links. The actual chooser isolates name, value, and required to avoid draft submission or permanent invalidity.
Requires browser formdata support. A jsdom event bridge does not verify native FormData construction.
Rules are application constraints; list/drop layout is a choice. Styles use existing roles without new numeric tokens.
The chooser displays its action name and clears for reselection. The separate list expresses accepted files. Its decorative span creates no second interaction entry.

metadata.title: 链接预览 HoverCard
metadata.description: 悬停与键盘焦点展开相同补充内容。
metadata.descriptionEn: Reveal the same supplemental content on hover and keyboard focus.
metadata.decisions: 默认触发是可到达链接；补充内容不唯一承载后果，Tab 主动离开时不抢回焦点。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use a reachable link by default. Supplemental content cannot carry the only consequence information; do not reclaim focus after deliberate navigation.

api.name: HoverCard
api.description: Base UI PreviewCard 公共 Root，保留 open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange、payload、handle 和 closeDelay。
api.descriptionEn: Public Base UI PreviewCard Root, retaining open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange, payload, handle, and closeDelay.

api.name: HoverCardTrigger
api.description: 真实可到达入口与键盘同源预览。
api.descriptionEn: An actual reachable entry with a keyboard-accessible preview from the same source.

props.name: href
props.description: 原生链接要求非空真实目标；自定义 render 须提供等价键盘可达性。
props.descriptionEn: Native links need nonblank real targets; custom render must provide equivalent keyboard access.

props.name: delay
props.description: 悬停进入时延；即时为当前选择，focus 仍由原语管理。
props.descriptionEn: Hover entry delay; immediate is the current choice, while the primitive still manages focus.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.description: 保留原语组合和状态回调。
props.descriptionEn: Retain primitive composition and state callbacks.

api.name: HoverCardPopup
api.description: 自身定位上下文的补充内容。
api.descriptionEn: Supplementary content with its own positioning context.

props.name: side / align / sideOffset / alignOffset / anchor
props.description: 采用自身公开定位上下文。
props.descriptionEn: Uses its own public positioning context.

props.name: portalProps / positionerProps
props.description: 容器、ref、render、事件和样式透传；共享 popup 层级先合并，调用方 style 最后合并。
props.descriptionEn: Forwards containers, refs, render, events, and styles; shared popup layers merge first, caller style last.

keyboard.description: 焦点到链接时展开；主动移开不抢回。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Focus on the link opens the preview; moving away never reclaims focus.

keyboard.description: 结束预览。
keyboard.descriptionEn: End the preview.

keyboard.description: 到达链接目标。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Follow the link target.

notes: 关键后果也必须在持续可见的位置可达。
需要执行局部动作时按任务选择 Popover。
透明边界、面、文字和入退复用公共角色；没有虚构对象或请求。
notesEn: Critical consequences must also remain reachable in a persistent location.
Choose Popover when the task needs local actions.
Transparent boundaries, surfaces, text, and motion use public roles; no invented objects or requests.

whenToUse: 链接需要同源、可键盘到达的补充预览。
avoid: 唯一重要信息只在 hover 时出现。
composition: 真实链接与补充内容；独立 Positioner 消费共享层级。

library: 悬停/focus 状态、定位与退出。
application: 链接目标、真实内容与后果。

responsive: 长内容换行，容量受原语 available width/height 限制。
customization: surface-raised、panel-padding-sm、文字角色与 motion.css。

whenToUse: A link needs a keyboard-accessible supplementary preview from the same source.
avoid: Important information available only on hover.
composition: An actual link with supplementary content; an independent Positioner consumes shared layers.

library: Hover/focus states, positioning, and exit.
application: Link targets, actual content, and consequences.

responsive: Long content wraps; primitive available width/height constrain capacity.
customization: surface-raised, panel-padding-sm, text roles, and motion.css.

metadata.title: 输入组合 InputGroup
metadata.description: 让输入与标记、单位或附属动作共用编辑边界。
metadata.descriptionEn: Give an input and its markers, units or actions one editing boundary.
metadata.decisions: InputGroupInput 复用 Input 的 unstyled 出口。静态附件不抢焦点；需要动作时组合 Button，并保留动作自己的名称与状态。
metadata.decisionsEn: InputGroupInput uses Input's unstyled outlet. Static addons do not redirect focus; compose Button for actions and keep their own names and states.

whenToUse: 输入与单位、标记或附属动作属于同一编辑范围。
avoid: 把无关动作附在输入上；只靠附件或 Placeholder 命名输入。
composition: FieldLabel 命名输入；附件的必要说明由 aria-describedby 显式关联。已有搜索和密码形态直接用 Input。

library: 共同边界、五档尺寸及 Input 的原生交互。
application: 输入值、附件动作、名称及校验事实。

responsive: 输入占剩余宽度；尺寸读取同名文字和控件档，粗指针目标单独保持。
customization: root 样式属于共同边界，Input 的 className/style/render/ref 属于实际输入；附件有独立 render。

whenToUse: An input shares one editing scope with units, markers, or adjunct actions.
avoid: Unrelated actions attached to an input; naming the input through an adjunct or placeholder alone.
composition: FieldLabel names the input; aria-describedby explicitly associates necessary adjunct explanations. Existing search/password forms use Input directly.

library: Shared boundary, five size profiles, and Input's native interaction.
application: Input values, adjunct actions, names, and validation facts.

responsive: Input takes remaining width; matching text/control profiles determine dimensions while coarse-pointer targets remain separate.
customization: Root styles own the shared boundary. Input className/style/render/refs own the actual input; adjuncts have independent render.

api.name: InputGroup
api.description: 共同编辑边界，不自动建立另一个字段角色。
api.descriptionEn: A shared editing boundary with no extra field role.

props.name: size
props.description: 外部边界与内部 Input 同一档；具体值为基础层预设。
props.descriptionEn: One profile for the outer boundary and inner Input; values are foundation presets.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 共同边界组合入口。
props.descriptionEn: Composition props for the common boundary.

api.name: InputGroupInput
api.description: Input 的 unstyled 组合，尺寸来自组。
api.descriptionEn: Input's unstyled composition with the group's size.

props.name: InputProps（除 size / unstyled）
props.description: 保留原生输入、受控值、搜索/密码、nativeInput 与实际输入 ref。
props.descriptionEn: Retains native input props, controlled values, search/password, nativeInput and the actual input ref.

api.name: InputGroupAddon
api.description: 默认静态 span；不添加 tabIndex、聚焦处理或自动名称。
api.descriptionEn: A static span by default, with no tabIndex, focus redirection or automatic name.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 单位、标记或显式 Button 的承载位。
props.descriptionEn: A position for units, markers or an explicit Button.

notes: FieldControl 注册组合时传 InputGroupInput nativeInput，避免重复注册。
禁用输入不意味着禁用任意附属动作；应用应声明每个动作的真实状态。
notesEn: Use InputGroupInput nativeInput when FieldControl registers the composition, avoiding duplicate registration.
Disabling the input does not disable arbitrary addon actions; the application declares each action's real state.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 输入框 Input
metadata.description: 输入一个文本值。搜索、密码与清空动作使用同一个输入入口。
metadata.descriptionEn: Enter one text value. Search, password visibility, and clearing use the same input.
metadata.decisions: 输入框只持有输入值；搜索结果与提交由调用方处理。Placeholder 不能代替持续可见的名称。
metadata.decisionsEn: Input holds the entered value; the caller handles search results and submission. A placeholder does not replace a persistent visible name.

whenToUse: 输入一个文本值，原生 type 与内容匹配；搜索结果和提交行为由组合负责。
avoid: 用 placeholder 代替名称；把超时变成无效；把未知转成空串或 0；校验失败清空草稿。
composition: 与 FieldLabel、FieldDescription、FieldError 共处；额外单位、标记和动作交给 InputGroup。

library: 原生输入、Field 关联、焦点、清空与密码可见性。
application: 值的含义、校验事实、候选范围、未知/不适用及送达结果。

responsive: xs/sm/md/lg/xl 消费基础层档案；窄屏增加 4px，粗指针编辑区至少 44px。
customization: className、style、render 与 ref 属于真实 input；controlClassName 属于编辑边界。

whenToUse: Enter one text value with a matching native type; composition owns search results and submission.
avoid: Placeholders replacing names; timeouts treated as invalid; unknown converted to empty or zero; drafts cleared after validation failure.
composition: Keep FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError together; InputGroup supplies extra units, markers, and actions.

library: Native input, Field associations, focus, clearing, and password visibility.
application: Value meaning, validation facts, candidate scope, unknown/not-applicable values, and delivery outcomes.

responsive: xs/sm/md/lg/xl use foundation profiles; narrow heights add 4px and coarse-pointer editing areas are at least 44px.
customization: className, style, render, and refs belong to the actual input; controlClassName belongs to its editing boundary.

api.name: Input
api.description: 真实边框界定编辑区；Base UI Input 保留 Field 注册和原生属性。
api.descriptionEn: A real border identifies the editable area. Base UI Input retains Field registration and native attributes.

props.name: type
props.description: search 加搜索标记与可清空动作；password 加可见性开关。不会自动补名称或 placeholder。
props.descriptionEn: search adds a search marker and clearing; password adds visibility. Neither supplies a field name or placeholder.

props.name: size
props.description: 位置对应的几何与控件文字档；数字保留原生 size 的字符宽度含义。
props.descriptionEn: Geometry and control text profile for the location. A number retains native size semantics.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.type: 原生值 / 初始值 / (value, details) => void
props.typeEn: Native value / initial value / (value, details) => void
props.description: 支持受控与非受控值；onChange 同样透传。清空沿同一事件链更新值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled and uncontrolled values; onChange is also forwarded. Clearing follows the same native change path.

props.name: clearable / clearLabel / onClear
props.description: 非空可编辑值可清空；按钮返回输入焦点。禁用与只读时隐藏。
props.descriptionEn: Clear a nonempty editable value and return focus to the input. Hidden when disabled or read only.

props.name: visibilityToggle
props.description: password 的可选附属动作，不更改内容或提交表单。
props.descriptionEn: Optional password adjunct that preserves the value and does not submit a form.

props.name: visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange
props.description: 独立支持受控与非受控可见性。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled or uncontrolled password visibility.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: 可见性开关的稳定名称，默认从 locale 读取；aria-pressed 表达当前可见性。
props.descriptionEn: Stable toggle name from the locale by default. aria-pressed reports visibility.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: 保留焦点、复制与表单提交，阻止编辑与清空；默认显示只读标记。
props.descriptionEn: Retains focus, copying, and form submission while blocking edits and clearing. Shows a read-only marker.

props.name: className / style / render / ref
props.description: 全部作用于真实 input；className/style 支持状态函数。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the real input. className/style support state functions.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: 调整共同编辑边界，例如宽度与所在布局；不替代原生属性。
props.descriptionEn: Styles the shared editable boundary, including its width and placement.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: 由 InputGroup 等公共组合承担边界；保留内高、档案与原生状态。
props.descriptionEn: Lets a public composition such as InputGroup supply the boundary while retaining inner geometry and native state.

props.name: nativeInput
props.description: 已由 FieldControl 或其他原语注册时使用原生出口；保留 render/ref/事件，避免重复注册。
props.descriptionEn: Native outlet for an input already registered by FieldControl or another primitive. Retains render, refs, and events without double registration.

keyboard.description: 在输入与可用附属动作之间移动；禁用动作不进入顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move between the input and available adjuncts. Disabled actions leave the tab order.

keyboard.description: 可清空且非空时清空，后续 Escape 返回外层；输入法组字及调用方取消时保留草稿。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Clear an eligible nonempty value; a later Escape reaches the parent. Composition and caller cancellation preserve the draft.

keyboard.description: 焦点在附属按钮上时立即执行，不提交表单。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Activate a focused adjunct immediately without submitting the form.

notes: aria-invalid 来自应用或浏览器校验；值的真伪与是否送达分开表达。
提供 FieldLabel、原生 label 或 aria-label。Placeholder 是输入提示，不是名称。
原 SearchInput / PasswordInput 改为 Input type="search" / type="password"；loading 与 shortcut 改为明确的状态或 InputGroup 组合。size="default" 改为 "md"；旧外框 className 改为 controlClassName。
type="file" 保留浏览器文件选择行为与语言；文件列表和业务校验由调用方提供。
notesEn: aria-invalid comes from application or browser validation. Value validity and delivery are separate facts.
Provide FieldLabel, a native label, or aria-label. A placeholder is a hint rather than a name.

Replace SearchInput / PasswordInput with Input type="search" / type="password". Express loading and shortcuts through explicit state or InputGroup composition. Replace size="default" with "md" and outer className with controlClassName.
type="file" retains browser behavior and language. The caller owns file lists and business validation.

metadata.title: 条目 Item
metadata.description: 内容、入口与附属动作的关系。
metadata.descriptionEn: Content, navigation and related actions.
metadata.decisions: 条目不内建业务对象。整体链接不包含其他交互动作；有附属动作时链接与按钮保持兄弟关系。
metadata.decisionsEn: Items contain no built-in business objects. A whole-item link cannot contain interactive controls; separate links and buttons when secondary actions exist.

whenToUse: 一个通用条目需要名称、补充内容与相关动作。
avoid: 多维比较使用 Table；不为没有目的的条目生成链接。

library: 条目关系、render 转发与焦点。
application: 条目内容、真实导航目标与操作状态。

responsive: 正文可换行，附属动作保留容量。

whenToUse: A general item needs a name, supplementary content, and related actions.
avoid: Use Table for multidimensional comparison; do not create links without an actual destination.

library: Item relationships, render forwarding, and focus.
application: Item content, actual navigation targets, and action states.

responsive: Body text wraps while adjunct actions retain capacity.

api.name: Item
api.description: 默认 div，可 render 为 li 或独立 a。
api.descriptionEn: A div that may render a li or standalone anchor.

props.name: render / ref / children / native props
props.description: 实际元素接收事件与 ref；列表中显式 render 为 li。
props.descriptionEn: Events and ref reach the actual element; explicitly render li inside a list.

api.name: ItemContent / ItemTitle / ItemDescription / ItemActions
api.description: div / div / p / div 关系槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / div / p / div relationship slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 标题不是默认章节标题；动作组合公共 Button。
props.descriptionEn: The title is not automatically a document heading; compose public Button actions.

api.name: ItemLink
api.description: 真实导航链接。
api.descriptionEn: A real navigation link.

props.name: href / render / ref / native props
props.description: 保留目标、ARIA 和消费者事件。
props.descriptionEn: Preserve destinations, ARIA and caller events.

keyboard.description: 实际链接与按钮沿用原生顺序。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Actual links and buttons use native focus order.

notes: 不在 a 中嵌套按钮、链接或其他交互控件；无需动作时不生成假入口。
notesEn: Never nest buttons, links or interactive controls inside an anchor; absent actions generate no fake entry.

metadata.title: 键位 Kbd
metadata.description: 用原生键位元素显示真实快捷键。
metadata.descriptionEn: A native keyboard key display.
metadata.decisions: Kbd 不注册键盘监听，不是可点击入口。
metadata.decisionsEn: Kbd neither registers keyboard listeners nor provides a clickable entry.

whenToUse: 说明实际可用的键位。
avoid: Kbd 不注册键盘监听，不是可点击入口。
composition: 组合原生 kbd 内容；平台键位由应用确定。

library: 原生语义、公共组合与集中角色。
application: 对象、内容、值、状态与请求结果。

responsive: 实际键位保持原生展示，长键位名称允许换行；不建立点击或触摸入口。
customization: 使用公开 render/ref、ARIA、事件与样式；不混用主题三轴。

whenToUse: Describe actually available keys.
avoid: Kbd neither registers keyboard listeners nor provides a clickable entry.
composition: Compose native kbd content; the application determines platform keys.

library: Native semantics, public composition, and centralized roles.
application: Objects, content, values, states, and request outcomes.

responsive: Display actual keys natively; long key names may wrap without establishing click or touch entries.
customization: Public render/refs, ARIA, events, and styles; keep theme axes independent.

api.name: Kbd
api.description: 组合原生 kbd 内容；平台键位由应用确定。
api.descriptionEn: Compose native kbd content; the application determines platform key mappings.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 属性、事件与ref透传实际元素；样式由className/style调整。
props.descriptionEn: Forward attributes, events, and refs to the actual element; adjust presentation through className/style.

metadata.title: 标签 Label
metadata.description: 用原生标签为一个控件命名。
metadata.descriptionEn: Name one control with a native label.
metadata.decisions: Field 内使用 FieldLabel。通用 Label 用 htmlFor 或原生嵌套关联一个控件，不能用 Placeholder 替代。
metadata.decisionsEn: Use FieldLabel inside Field. A standalone Label associates one control through htmlFor or native nesting; a placeholder cannot replace it.

whenToUse: 原生控件需要持续可读的名称。
avoid: 用通用 Label 替代 Field 内的注册标签。
composition: 用 htmlFor 指向 Input 或 NativeSelect 的实际 id。

library: 原生标签关联与 text-label 角色。
application: 名称、控件 id 与状态。

responsive: 长名称允许换行。
customization: className、style 与 render 属于标签。

whenToUse: A native control needs a persistent readable name.
avoid: Replacing Field's registered label with a general Label.
composition: htmlFor points to the actual id of Input or NativeSelect.

library: Native label association and the text-label role.
application: Names, control ids, and state.

responsive: Long names can wrap.
customization: className, style, and render belong to the label.

api.name: Label
api.description: 默认原生 label。
api.descriptionEn: A native label by default.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: 实际控件的 id。
props.descriptionEn: The actual control id.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 保留标签语义、事件、ref 与原生属性。替换标签元素后需显式维护命名关系。
props.descriptionEn: Preserves semantics, events, ref and native attributes. An alternate tag must provide an explicit naming relationship.

notes: Label 不拥有禁用状态；被命名控件使用自己的真实 disabled。
notesEn: Label owns no disabled state; the named control uses its real disabled attribute.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 布局 Layout
metadata.description: 用纵向堆叠与横向排列组织内容，间隔按字段、动作、面板或分节关系选择。
metadata.descriptionEn: Arrange content vertically or side by side using field, action, panel and section spacing roles.
metadata.decisions: Stack 纵向排列，Inline 横向排列并默认换行。gap 选择字段、动作或分节关系；语义由 render 与内容提供。
metadata.decisionsEn: Stack flows vertically; Inline flows horizontally and wraps by default. Choose field, action or section spacing with gap; render and content supply semantics.

api.name: Stack
api.description: 按内容顺序纵向排列。
api.descriptionEn: Vertical content flow.

props.name: gap
props.description: 分别读取 field-gap、field-group-gap、action-gap、panel-gap、section-gap。
props.descriptionEn: Reads the corresponding relationship token.

props.name: align
props.description: 横轴对齐。
props.descriptionEn: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 替换元素，透传事件、语言、方向、密度与原生属性。
props.descriptionEn: Replace the element and forward native props, events and environment attributes.

api.name: Inline
api.description: 相邻动作或内容，可换行。
api.descriptionEn: Adjacent actions or content with wrapping.

props.name: gap
props.description: 与 Stack 相同的关系角色。
props.descriptionEn: The same relationship roles as Stack.

props.name: align
props.description: 横排的垂直对齐。
props.descriptionEn: Vertical alignment in a row.

props.name: wrap
props.description: 保留全部内容并允许折行。false 需由消费方验证容量。
props.descriptionEn: Retains all content and permits wrapping. Consumers must verify capacity when false.

props.name: render / ref / 原生属性
props.description: 默认 div；没有自动 group/toolbar 语义。
props.descriptionEn: Defaults to div with no automatic group or toolbar role.

notes: 布局没有边框、表面、内边距或业务状态；独立对象边界用 Card。
角色数值是主题预设。确有特殊关系时在项目组合说明 className/style 覆写理由。
方向、语言与密度沿真实 DOM 继承；换行不改变内容顺序。
notesEn: Layout adds no border, surface, padding or business state; use Card for independent object boundaries.
Role values are theme presets. Explain special className/style overrides in the project composition.

metadata.descriptionEn: Native two-dimensional relationships with complete comparison columns.
metadata.decisions: 原生表格保留比较关系，外部容器承接横向容量。行占位与单元格内距消费独立角色；疏密取值是预设。
metadata.decisionsEn: Native table structure preserves comparison; the container handles horizontal capacity. Row occupancy and cell padding consume independent roles; density values are presets.

whenToUse: 多个对象需要按共同维度比较。
avoid: 单一对象名称值关系用 DescriptionList；长阅读正文用 Typography。

library: 原生二维结构、表头关系与滚动容量。
application: 数据、表名、排序、错误、未知与空结果。

responsive: 横向滚动保留完整比较列，不改成丢维度的卡片。

whenToUse: Compare multiple objects along shared dimensions.
avoid: Use DescriptionList for one object's names/values and Typography for long reading.

library: Native two-dimensional structure, header relationships, and scrolling capacity.
application: Data, table names, sorting, errors, unknown, and empty results.

responsive: Horizontal scrolling retains complete comparison columns instead of cards losing dimensions.

api.name: TableContainer
api.description: 横向滚动容器。
api.descriptionEn: A horizontal scroll container.

props.name: tabIndex / aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: ref 属于容器；允许键盘滚动。
props.descriptionEn: Ref targets the container; keyboard scrolling remains available.

api.name: Table / TableCaption / TableHeader / TableBody / TableFooter / TableRow
api.description: table / caption / thead / tbody / tfoot / tr。
api.descriptionEn: Native table / caption / thead / tbody / tfoot / tr.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性属于真实元素；caption 命名整张表。
props.descriptionEn: Props reach actual elements; caption names the table.

api.name: TableHead
api.description: th；应用提供排序状态。
api.descriptionEn: A th with application-owned sort state.

props.name: scope
props.description: 行标题用 row；复杂表格可用 id/headers。
props.descriptionEn: Use row for row headers; complex tables may use id/headers.

props.name: aria-sort / children / native props
props.description: 排序交应用 Button 组合，库不重排 rows。
props.descriptionEn: Compose an application Button to sort; the library never reorders rows.

api.name: TableCell
api.description: td，零值原样呈现。
api.descriptionEn: A td that preserves zero.

props.name: colSpan / rowSpan / headers / render / ref / native props
props.description: 显式提供跨列和关联表头，不隐藏比较列。
props.descriptionEn: Supply spans and header associations explicitly; comparison columns are not hidden.

notes: 空结果可在完整表头下提供跨列单元格；数据与排序由应用提供。
notesEn: Empty results may use a spanning cell below complete headers; data and sorting belong to the application.

metadata.title: 视角标签 Tabs
metadata.description: 同一对象的不同视角，保留面板草稿。
metadata.descriptionEn: Different views of one object with panel drafts retained.
metadata.decisions: 默认手动激活、面板保留挂载；切换视角不等于批准或保存草稿。
metadata.decisionsEn: Manual activation and mounted panels are defaults; switching views does not approve or save a draft.

api.name: Tabs / TabsList
api.description: 当前视角与手动激活列表。
api.descriptionEn: The current view and a manually activated list.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange / orientation
props.description: 值由应用或原语持有；取消不切换。
props.descriptionEn: The application or primitive owns the value; cancellation prevents a switch.

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: 默认焦点移动不自动切换；消费者可明确选择自动激活。
props.descriptionEn: Focus movement does not activate by default; consumers may explicitly opt in.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: TabsTab
api.description: 具有关联面板的 tab。
api.descriptionEn: A tab associated with a panel.

props.name: value / disabled
props.description: value 稳定；禁用标签可聚焦但不能激活。
props.descriptionEn: Value is stable; disabled tabs may receive focus but cannot activate.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

api.name: TabsPanel / TabsPrimitive
api.description: 原生 tabpanel 与公开原语。
api.descriptionEn: A tabpanel and public primitives.

props.name: value / keepMounted
props.description: 默认保留挂载与输入；false 由应用承担卸载后果。
props.descriptionEn: Mounted panels retain input by default; applications own the effects of false.

props.name: render / ref / native props
props.description: 属性和 ref 归属实际元素；调用方事件与样式保留。
props.descriptionEn: Props and refs target actual elements; caller events and styles are preserved.

notes: 隐藏面板仍挂载但退出可访问树；不要把切换当成保存成功。
notesEn: Hidden panels remain mounted but leave the accessibility tree; switching is never reported as saving.

whenToUse: 同一对象多种视角需要保留编辑连续性。
avoid: 步骤进度用 Steps，真实目的地用链接。

library: 标签关联、键盘和面板可见性。
application: value、草稿、保存与批准。

responsive: 桌面保持真实结构；菜单受可用空间限制，表格保留完整比较列。
customization: 控件档案、间距和浮层表面消费现有角色；具体外观是预设。

whenToUse: Multiple views of one object need editing continuity.
avoid: Use Steps for progression and links for actual destinations.

library: Tab associations, keyboard, and panel visibility.
application: value, drafts, saving, and approval.

responsive: Keep actual desktop structure; menus fit available space and tables retain complete comparison columns.
customization: Control profiles, spacing, and popup surfaces consume existing roles; their appearance is a preset.

keyboard.description: 移动标签焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move tab focus.

keyboard.description: 手动激活可用标签。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Manually activate an enabled tab.

metadata.title: 标签集合 TagInput
metadata.description: 确认字符串集合，保留尚未确认的编辑草稿。
metadata.descriptionEn: Confirm a string collection while keeping its unconfirmed draft.
metadata.decisions: Enter 或添加按钮才确认；两端空白去除，精确字符串去重且区分大小写。空项、重复项及受控拒绝不会清空草稿。
metadata.decisionsEn: Only Enter or Add confirms a tag. Confirmation trims surrounding whitespace and deduplicates exact case-sensitive strings. Empty, duplicate, and rejected changes retain the draft.

api.name: TagInput
api.description: 已确认项、草稿输入与非提交动作的公共组合。
api.descriptionEn: Public composition of confirmed items, a draft input, and non-submitting actions.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 已确认集合；外部事实不重新去重、裁切或清理。
props.descriptionEn: Confirmed collection. External facts are not re-deduplicated, truncated, or cleaned.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: details 有 add/remove、tag、event、cancel() 与 isCanceled；受控添加接受前保留草稿。
props.descriptionEn: Details includes add/remove, tag, event, cancel(), and isCanceled. Controlled additions retain the draft until accepted.

props.name: draft / defaultDraft / onDraftChange
props.description: 独立的待确认编辑文本；刷新集合不清草稿。
props.descriptionEn: Independent unconfirmed text. Refreshing the collection retains the draft.

props.name: name / form
props.description: 只提交确认项，使用同名表单键；草稿不提交为集合项。
props.descriptionEn: Submit confirmed items as repeated form keys; the draft does not become a collection item.

props.name: size
props.description: 草稿、确认项文字与动作使用同档角色。
props.descriptionEn: Draft, confirmed text, and actions use the same profile.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: 真实草稿 Input 的 render/ref/ARIA/事件/样式；FieldLabel 注册此入口。
props.descriptionEn: The real draft Input's render, refs, ARIA, events, and styling. FieldLabel registers this input.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 同时约束草稿与确认项操作；只读仍提交确认项，禁用不提交。
props.descriptionEn: Constrain the draft and item actions together. Read-only confirmed items submit; disabled items do not.

props.name: render / ref / className / style / native props
props.description: 属于根容器；改渲染元素须保持结构与子控件。
props.descriptionEn: Applied to the root container. Render must retain its structure and children.

keyboard.description: 非组字时确认草稿，阻止表单提交；组字中的 Enter 不添加。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Confirm the draft outside composition without submitting a form. Composition Enter does not add.

keyboard.description: 空草稿的 Backspace 或起点的左箭头先聚焦最后一项，不立即删除。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Backspace on an empty draft or Left at its start focuses the last item without deleting it.

keyboard.description: 移除已聚焦项，保留相邻焦点位置。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Remove the focused item and preserve an adjacent focus position.

keyboard.description: 在确认项间移动，边界返回草稿。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move among confirmed items; boundaries return to the draft.

notes: FieldLabel 命名草稿入口，FieldDescription 可明示确认和去重规则。
粘贴只编辑草稿，不自动拆分或批量确认。
添加/移除不是保存结果；库不发请求、不清失败草稿。
模拟 composition 已验证，真实中文输入法与辅助技术另验。
notesEn: FieldLabel names the draft; FieldDescription may state confirmation and duplicate rules.
Paste edits the draft without splitting or bulk confirmation.
Adding/removing is not persistence. The library sends no requests and retains failed drafts.
Synthetic composition is checked; real IME and assistive tech need separate verification.

whenToUse: 由用户逐项确认的短字符串集合
avoid: 只能从候选选择时用 Select/Combobox；单值用 Input
composition: Field + FieldLabel + TagInput + FieldDescription / Error

library: 非受控集合与草稿、焦点、约束提示
application: 受控集合/草稿、权限、刷新、失败与持久化

responsive: 确认项允许换行，草稿取剩余宽度；五档同名 control/text
customization: root render/ref 与 inputProps 的真实输入出口分开

whenToUse: Short strings confirmed individually by the user.
avoid: Use Select/Combobox when values must come from candidates, and Input for a single value.
composition: Field + FieldLabel + TagInput + FieldDescription / Error

library: Uncontrolled collection/draft, focus, and constraint feedback.
application: Controlled collection/draft, permissions, refresh, failure, and persistence.

responsive: Confirmed items wrap and drafts take remaining width; five matching control/text profiles.
customization: Root render/refs stay separate from inputProps for the actual input.

provenance.scope: Current library authorship classification; this generator does not perform independent provenance comparison.

metadata.title: 多行输入 Textarea
metadata.description: 编辑备注、消息等多行文本。
metadata.descriptionEn: Edit multiline notes and messages.

api.name: Textarea
api.description: 可与 Field 组合的原生 textarea。
api.descriptionEn: A native textarea composable with Field.

props.name: size
props.description: 同档控件几何、文字及有边框内距。
props.descriptionEn: Matching control geometry, text, and bordered padding.

props.name: rows
props.description: 最小起始行数；内容可自动增高，仍可手工调整高度。
props.descriptionEn: Minimum starting rows; content may grow automatically and still be resized manually.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 受控值或非受控初值。
props.descriptionEn: Controlled value or uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: 原语的值变化回调，可调用 eventDetails.cancel()。
props.descriptionEn: Primitive value callback, cancelable with eventDetails.cancel().

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: 调用方声明的错误事实；也可由 Field invalid 传入。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-declared error fact, also available from Field invalid.

props.name: disabled / readOnly
props.description: 禁用不参与 Tab/提交；只读仍可聚焦和提交，显示已有 locale 的只读文案。
props.descriptionEn: Disabled excludes tabbing/submission; read-only retains focus/submission and existing localized read-only text.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: 浏览器执行的字符长度上限，不由计数文案实施限制。
props.descriptionEn: Browser-enforced maximum text length; count text does not enforce it.

props.name: render / ref / className / style
props.type: Base UI render / textarea ref / state-aware styling
props.description: 真实 textarea 的组合与样式入口；render 必须保留 textarea 语义、属性及事件。
props.descriptionEn: Actual textarea composition/styling; render must retain textarea semantics, attributes, and events.

api.name: TextareaPrimitive
api.description: Base UI Field 命名空间；Textarea 使用其 Control 的 textarea render 出口。
api.descriptionEn: The Base UI Field namespace; Textarea uses its Control's textarea render outlet.

keyboard.description: 按文档顺序移动焦点。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Move focus in document order.

keyboard.description: 插入换行，不提交表单。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Insert a newline without form submission.

notes: 名称使用 FieldLabel 或真实 label；placeholder 不代替名称。
自动增高使用 CSS field-sizing:content；不支持时保留 rows 与原生手工调整。
错误、提交与持久化事实由应用提供，失败后保留草稿。
默认表面与尺寸是集中预设；聚焦只变边框颜色。
notesEn: FieldLabel or an actual label supplies names; placeholders cannot replace them.
Automatic growth uses CSS field-sizing:content. Unsupported environments retain rows and native manual resizing.
Applications supply error, submission, and persistence facts; retain drafts after failure.
Default surfaces/dimensions are central presets; focus changes border color only.
metadata.decisions: 字符计数只描述当前值。限制由 maxLength 或应用规则执行；错误内容不会让 Textarea 自行判定 invalid。
metadata.decisionsEn: Character counts describe the current value only. maxLength or application rules enforce limits; error text does not make Textarea infer invalid.

whenToUse: 多行纯文本、备注、消息
avoid: 单行值用 Input
富文本编辑需编辑器
composition: Field + FieldLabel + Textarea + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: 焦点、原生编辑、非受控值
application: 受控值、invalid、保存与错误事实

responsive: 同名文字档及 -narrow 尺寸已接线；本批只验桌面
customization: 已有控制档 token；className/style 属于实际 textarea

whenToUse: Multiline plain text, notes, or messages.
avoid: Use Input for single-line values.
Rich text needs an editor.
composition: Field + FieldLabel + Textarea + FieldDescription / FieldError

library: Focus, native editing, and uncontrolled values.
application: Controlled values, invalid, save, and error facts.

responsive: Matching text profiles and -narrow dimensions are wired; this batch checked desktop only.
customization: Existing control-profile tokens; className/style belong to the actual textarea.

metadata.title: 主题 ThemeProvider
metadata.description: 管理整个文档的浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统：记住用户的选择，跟随系统偏好变化，并把结果写到 <html> 上。在应用根部挂载一次，用 useTheme 读写。
metadata.descriptionEn: Remember the user's choice of light, dark, or system mode for the whole document. ThemeProvider follows system preference changes and applies the resolved mode to <html>. Mount it once at the app root and use useTheme to read or change the mode.

api.name: ThemeProvider
api.description: 主题上下文。在 <html> 上切换 .dark / .light 类（或 data-theme 属性），并同步 color-scheme。
api.descriptionEn: Theme context switches html .dark/.light classes or data-theme and synchronizes color-scheme.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: 没有保存过选择时使用。
props.descriptionEn: Used when no choice was saved.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: 保存到 localStorage 的键；传 null 不保存。其他标签页修改后会自动同步。
props.descriptionEn: The localStorage key; null disables persistence. Other tabs' changes synchronize automatically.

props.name: attribute
props.description: 写入方式：.dark 类，或 data-theme="dark"。两者样式都已支持。
props.descriptionEn: Write .dark classes or data-theme=dark; styles support both.

props.name: disableTransitionOnChange
props.description: 切换瞬间暂停过渡，所有表面同时变色，而不是以不同速度渐变。
props.descriptionEn: Pause transitions during switching so surfaces change together rather than fading at different speeds.

api.name: useTheme
api.description: 返回 { theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme }。theme 是用户的选择（可能为 system），resolvedTheme 是实际生效的 light 或 dark。必须在 ThemeProvider 内使用。
api.descriptionEn: Returns {theme,resolvedTheme,setTheme}. theme is the user's choice, possibly system; resolvedTheme is the actual light/dark mode. Requires ThemeProvider.

api.name: themeScript
api.description: 生成首屏前执行的内联脚本源码，参数与 ThemeProvider 相同（storageKey、attribute、defaultTheme）。
api.descriptionEn: Creates inline pre-paint script source with the same storageKey, attribute, and defaultTheme as ThemeProvider.

notes: 防止首屏闪烁：React 挂载前页面已经绘制，需要在 <head> 里、样式表之前放一段内联脚本先应用主题。单页应用把 themeScript() 的输出粘贴进 index.html 的 <script>；服务端渲染用 <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeScript() }} />。脚本参数必须与 ThemeProvider 一致。
主题选择的文案用语言包中的 theme、lightTheme、darkTheme、systemTheme。
选择“跟随系统”后，操作系统切换深浅色时页面立即跟随，无需刷新。
只在根部挂载一个 ThemeProvider；局部强制深色可在容器上加 .dark 类。
服务端与客户端首渲染保持 defaultTheme，挂载后读取真实选择。存储不可用仍可改变外观；卸载清理媒体/存储监听和临时过渡样式。
默认 yq-theme 保留已有真实偏好；跨标签页删除或 clear 恢复 defaultTheme。
notesEn: Prevent first-paint flashing with an inline head script before stylesheets, since painting precedes React mounting. In SPAs paste themeScript() into index.html script; SSR uses script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html:themeScript()}}. Options must match ThemeProvider.
Theme choice labels use locale theme/lightTheme/darkTheme/systemTheme.
System choice follows OS light/dark changes immediately without reloading.
Mount one root ThemeProvider. Local forced-dark content may add a .dark container class.
Server/client first renders retain defaultTheme, then read actual choices after mount. Appearance can change without storage; unmount cleans media/storage listeners and temporary transition styles.
The default yq-theme key retains actual existing preferences. Cross-tab deletion/clear restores defaultTheme.
metadata.decisions: ThemeProvider 把 data-theme 留给 light 和 dark；项目的品牌标记写在 data-brand，写进 data-theme 的品牌会在切换明暗时被覆盖。
metadata.decisionsEn: ThemeProvider reserves data-theme for light and dark. Store the project's brand identifier in data-brand; if ThemeProvider uses data-theme, it overwrites any brand identifier in that attribute when the mode changes.

whenToUse: 全应用共同选择浅色、深色或跟随系统，并在首屏一致应用。
avoid: 把品牌写进 data-theme；多个 Provider 竞争同一 html；Script 与 Provider 的持久化键不同。
composition: 根部一个 Provider 与同选项 themeScript 配对；useTheme 分别展示用户选择与实际 resolvedTheme。

library: 明暗应用、存储容错、系统偏好和跨标签页同步。
application: 品牌 data-brand、密度 data-density、主题选择入口与集中主题。

responsive: 主题切换保持对象、输入和焦点；真实控件、浮层与表面都检查明暗组合。
customization: attribute 只选 class 或明暗 data-theme，storageKey 决定偏好范围，品牌单独配置。

whenToUse: The whole application shares light/dark/system choices applied consistently at first paint.
avoid: Brand in data-theme, multiple Providers competing for html, or differing Script/Provider persistence keys.
composition: One root Provider paired with identically configured themeScript; useTheme distinguishes chosen theme from actual resolvedTheme.

library: Applying appearance, storage tolerance, system preferences, and cross-tab synchronization.
application: Brand data-brand, density data-density, choice entries, and the central theme.

responsive: Theme switching retains objects, inputs, and focus; check actual controls, popups, and surfaces in both modes.
customization: attribute selects class or appearance data-theme; storageKey sets preference scope and brand stays separate.

metadata.title: 时间序列 Timeline
metadata.description: 保留输入顺序与真实时间。
metadata.descriptionEn: Preserve input order and actual times.
metadata.decisions: ol/li 表达传入序列，time 保存可解析时间；不排序、不补事件、不伪造时间。
metadata.decisionsEn: ol/li express the input sequence; time preserves machine time. No sorting or invented events and times.

whenToUse: 呈现输入的时间事件序列。
avoid: 可执行的有序过程用 Steps；二维比较用 Table。

library: 序列、time 与内容关系。
application: 事件、输入顺序、时间格式与未知事实。

responsive: 内容完整换行，未知时间保持文字表达。

whenToUse: Present an input sequence of time events.
avoid: Use Steps for actionable ordered processes and Table for two-dimensional comparison.

library: Sequence, time elements, and content relationships.
application: Events, input order, time formatting, and unknown facts.

responsive: Content wraps fully and unknown times remain explicit text.

api.name: Timeline / TimelineItem
api.description: ol / li 按 children 顺序呈现。
api.descriptionEn: ol / li render in children order.

props.name: children / aria-label / render / ref / native props
props.description: 名称和事件由应用提供，未知时间可用文字。
props.descriptionEn: The caller supplies names and events; unknown times may use text.

api.name: TimelineTime
api.description: 原生 time。
api.descriptionEn: A native time element.

props.name: dateTime / children / render / ref
props.description: 机器时间与显示文本独立，应用负责真实性。
props.descriptionEn: Machine time and display text are independent application facts.

api.name: TimelineTitle / TimelineDescription
api.description: div / p 内容槽。
api.descriptionEn: div / p content slots.

props.name: children / render / ref / native props
props.description: 不推断成功、失败或业务对象。
props.descriptionEn: Infers no result or business object.

notes: 正序、逆序和相同时间输入都原样保留；空序列不补占位事件。
notesEn: Ascending, descending and tied times keep input order; an empty sequence generates no entries.

metadata.title: 通知 Toast
metadata.description: 补充可恢复、非关键的操作事实，保持当前工作不中断。
metadata.descriptionEn: Report recoverable, non-critical facts while the current work continues.

api.name: ToastProvider
api.description: 同一通知通道挂载一次。
api.descriptionEn: Mount once per notification channel.

props.name: position
props.description: 通知区域的位置。
props.descriptionEn: Notification region placement.

props.name: timeout
props.description: 普通通知与成功的阅读时限，0 为持续显示。
props.descriptionEn: Reading duration for ordinary/success notices; zero keeps them visible.

metadata.title: 虚拟列表 VirtualList
metadata.description: 以稳定项身份呈现等高长集合的可达窗口。
metadata.descriptionEn: An accessible window over a fixed-height collection with stable item identity.

api.name: VirtualList<Item>
api.description: 集合渲染边界，真实 list/listitem，不提供选择或业务列。
api.descriptionEn: Collection rendering boundary with actual list/listitem semantics, without selection or business columns.

props.name: items / getKey / renderItem
props.description: 真实集合、稳定唯一 key 与内容；重复 key 显式报错。不得用不稳定位置冒充项身份。
props.descriptionEn: Actual collection, stable unique keys, and content; duplicate keys throw. Unstable positions cannot impersonate identity.

props.name: itemSize / height
props.description: 调用方提供等高项外高与视口高，CSS px；有限正数，0/无穷等显式报错。总高/偏移/窗口从关系计算。
props.descriptionEn: Caller-supplied equal outer item height and viewport height in CSS px. Finite positive values; zero/infinity throw. Total height, offsets, and window derive from these relationships.

props.name: overscan
props.description: 窗口两侧的渲染预算预设，非负整数；不是视觉尺寸。
props.descriptionEn: A nonnegative integer rendering-budget preset on both window edges, rather than a visual dimension.

props.name: render / ref / style / className / events / ARIA
props.description: 真实滚动视口出口；height 由显式 height 参数承担，测量实际 clientHeight 适应视口变化。给集合可识别名称。
props.descriptionEn: Actual viewport composition; explicit height owns its height, and measured clientHeight adapts to viewport changes. Give the collection an identifiable name.

keyboard.description: 到达集合视口与已挂载的内部操作。
keyboard.descriptionEn: Reach the collection viewport and mounted internal actions.

keyboard.description: 从视口或行本身到相邻/首末真实行，跨窗口滚动挂载；内嵌编辑/按钮键位不被接管。
keyboard.descriptionEn: From the viewport or row, reach adjacent/first/last actual rows, scrolling/mounting across windows. Embedded editing/button keys remain intact.

notes: 只有等高项；动态高度、完整 DOM 搜索/打印使用普通集合或 ScrollArea。
聚焦行即使离屏也保留挂载；真实移除后焦点回到视口，可继续导航。aria-posinset/setsize 表达完整集合位置。
示例行高 48px 是消费示例选择，视口容纳四项；修改入口是示例 rowSize 与组件 itemSize/height，未新增库 token。
notesEn: Equal-height items only. Use ordinary collections or ScrollArea for dynamic height, complete DOM search, or printing.
Focused rows remain mounted offscreen; actual removal returns focus to the viewport so navigation can continue. aria-posinset/setsize identify positions in the complete collection.
The example's 48px row height is a consumer choice with four visible rows. Adjust example rowSize or component itemSize/height; no library token was added.
metadata.decisions: VirtualList 不代表选择、加载或业务结果。稳定 key、等高项和可达窗口是当前契约；overscan=2 是渲染预算预设。
metadata.decisionsEn: VirtualList expresses no selection, loading, or business result. Stable keys, equal-height items, and a reachable window are its current contract; overscan=2 is a rendering-budget preset.

library: Windowing, actual positions, and focus continuity.
